kept.excerpt: In a first-round scenario, Quaest had Lula leading with 37% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (33%), Cury (6%) and Caiado (4%). Quaest surveyed 2,004 people from September 17 to 20; the margin of error is 2 percentage points. In a first-round scenario, Lula would lead with 40% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (37%), Augusto Cury (6%) and Ronaldo Caiado (5%). Nexus surveyed 2,006 people from September 18 to 20.
kept.relevance: The latest eligible report supplies two independent first-round polls, both showing substantial support for candidates beyond the two frontrunners; these voting-intention percentages should not automatically be treated as valid-vote shares.

kept.excerpt: In a first-round scenario, Lula would receive 44.1% of voter support, followed by Bolsonaro with 41.7%, Renan Santos with 5.1%, and Augusto Cury with 3.5%. AtlasIntel surveyed 5,018 people between September 11 and 16. The poll has a margin of error of 1 percentage point.
kept.relevance: AtlasIntel provides a separate recent measurement of how close either leading candidate was to an outright majority, with its sample period and uncertainty stated.

kept.excerpt: In a first-round scenario, Lula had 39%, compared with 36% for Flavio Bolsonaro.
kept.relevance: Datafolha adds another pollster's contemporaneous first-round estimate, allowing comparison with the higher frontrunner percentages reported by AtlasIntel.

kept.publisher: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP)
kept.excerpt: As Eleições 2026 acontecerão no dia 4 de outubro, primeiro domingo do mês. Já se houver segundo turno, ele ocorrerá no último domingo do mesmo mês, 25 de outubro. Nesses casos, no primeiro turno, vence o candidato que receber a maioria absoluta dos votos válidos, sem contar votos brancos e nulos. Caso isso não aconteça, a Justiça Eleitoral organiza um segundo turno, contando apenas com os dois candidatos mais votados.
kept.relevance: This official electoral-court explanation establishes the election dates and the decisive valid-vote denominator, excluding blank and null ballots.

kept.excerpt: As únicas vezes em que a eleição foi decidida no primeiro turno foram em 1994 e 1998, quando Fernando Henrique Cardoso (PSDB) saiu como vencedor.
kept.relevance: This dated historical report documents the rarity of first-round presidential victories since direct elections resumed in 1989, providing a base-rate reference.
